notes.title: 1.50 VOLCANO
notes.content:
[h2]1.50 VOLCANO update[/h2]
update to 1.5.1 on 4/17/23

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/f6d5c29ee88511510c87fae32d496364e0fba753.png[/img]

A plenty of changes in game. Game pace is much faster in ten, twenty minutes You can have plenty of resources and a lot of tunnels already dig out.  A lot of restrictions not present in game anymore. Easier selection/order system, easier DIG system, auto build ladder for vertical movement after tile is dig out. 
In summary now RoundOnes  can BUILD those World wonders much easier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/ee7a923f5af8f20013ce8a9fbc4225018bd865ba.png[/img]



[h2]NEW main features:[/h2]

- new selection/issue orders system - use left mouse button to select and right to give order. Like in  RTS games. Very easy and convenient way . Nothing in game is done automatically anymore. This means if 
villager is hungry you need to select him and move him to TABLE build to replenish food. 
Now building and digging is much easier. Each villager can do independent task. Access to DROPZONE is not that much necessary anymore - which is good for playability.

- new access to specifics actions. Some BUILDS have some advanced action associated with them you can access them with new menu. Usually those are to CONFIGURE build or mixer, DELIVER some additional material to that build. Menu will show only actions for selected specific item - for example MIXER actions might be different than TABLE or STOVE.

- new redesigned MACHINES - after placing machine on map like any regular build - you can move it when digging is necessary and choose dig zone for it. After that activate digging. Machines are reusable.

- new BUILDS. redesigned refactored all builds in game and added some new exciting build types.
To be specific those can be configured - usually with some resources which you have in dropzone and that later needs to be delivered to that BUILD. For example BED to be functioning will need some kind of cushion to get better rest for villager. So configure BED with wool resource and deliver that to that build to fully activate it. Its very easy and will allow you to use what you have currently in dropzone.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/3de4350cdcfe8e56674ccd1edf2d76b4201ae18d.png[/img]

-new  tiles in game - most important ones are: water and active lava. Water as flowing fluid will go down and is going to flood empty tiles. 
Lava will flow in all direction and take existing tiles from map. Lava will build up and place maximum 2 volcanoes on map. Volcanos will grow few tiles up and in that process maybe will destroy some builds.
Lava on other hand is blocked by BUILDS. So build a lot and then lava will be blocked.
All this means that right now You actually play against lava.

- new redesigned TECH TREE (former encyclopedia) Very useful to see and decide what MIXER should mix. Now automatically configuring new Mixer from within TECH TREE.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/726a771206c12c0ccfb427dacd2461ebd1f787a7.png[/img]

- new DIG system for villagers and machines. They DIG and throw material behind them - as boxes with material. Then those boxes needs to be collected.

- new redesigned GUI elements - gui is simpler now, more streamlined - for example you selects some build and only specific actions allowed for that build will be shown. Game window can be just grabbed and size adjusted to fit yours screen. Looks very nice on wide screens.
Mini map refactored to fit better world sizes. Now  game world can be created in way you wont to play: if you need more surface for farming and animals then create very wide world, if You wont to dig more than create map which is longer vertically and you will have plenty of dig tiles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/9849a54e9ba1f54a27127871de0399d734b43886.png[/img]

A ton of other small fixes, changes, refactoring.
A ton of game features not clear how to use or just cluttering was removed from game.
I hope game will be better and fun to play. BUILD those wonders in game and show them to Yours friends. Thank You
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/9714e3aebbd5eac47669d870bd62207c303e9f5b.png[/img]

#update 1.5.1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/a35e48fdd766c9907e8d232bcbf712bc2feb708f.png[/img]
-added some nice sprites for farming buildings: cows barn, sheep barn, chicken house, bees house.
-fixed floor builds - collision shape
-added advanced builds advice





older game saves will not work after that update.
thank you

notes.title: EARTH'S ELEMENTS UPDATE coming soon
notes.content:
Welcome
New update coming soon. I am in about 75 percent done with that rework.
Basically that will feel like new game.
I put a lot of effort since beginning of this year into this project. Lets give you some specifics:


A. Reworked whole units selection/orders
-unit selection. with mouse left mouse button dragging to select like in RTS style.
-with that comes independent orders to units. every unit could do different task. one can dig other could build, they could cooperate. You will have ability to select unit and tell it to go whenever you wont with right click button.

Now basically using left mouse button to select and right mouse click to give orders game feels much better. finally player will be in control what units are doing.

B. reworked /refactored tiles and maps and minimap too. Newest tile is water - fluid tile will spread. (cell automata mechanics. very interesting.) 
You can choose narrow but deep map for more digging, or if you planning farming game - then select wide and huge map.

C. reworked/refactored almost every builds.
Added some new builds - builds with functionality. Cooking stove - producing hot meals looks nice. 
Builds could be even placed in air. Roundones don't need to go to build to place it.
With that some explanation is needed to game mechanics. I loosen many restrictions. RoundOnes can dig even without access to DROPZONE, and build too. So exploring and digging on tunnels finally is fun. On those screenshots RoundOnes dig that tunnels tiles in about 10 minutes of play time.  so in summary many restrictions gone. better play.

To do:
I still have huge aspect of game to work on - MACHINEs, and ENCYCLOPEDIA and SAVE and LOAD.
Yes. and GUI was reworked too - its much cleaner, simpler.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/db69e9538c292630c4275c92ebaae17b0c7dbddc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/4cbc6c28a5e14a6bfa8910c6d4911a6bc7f716f3.png[/img]


Thank You
those are only highlights of main changes.
update coming soon

As a reminder short description how to handle animals:
-animal is wild by default - red square by animal. It means it will destroy BUILDS on map
-animals can be domesticated - to do that use DOMESTICATED field and choose which animal to domesticate. Than DOMESTICATED animals behavior will change - will NOT destroy BUILDS, and will provide energy every 100 steps to central ENERGY counter, DOG will send energy to his owner directly.
After DOMESTICATED pElement is fully set you can collect it. Depending on animal those will provide:
eggs - if you domesticated chicken
milk - if you domesticated cows,
honey -bees

Tile work before was dependent on distance to dropzpone, now that is eliminated all tiles will take the same amount to dig - you can change that doing upgrades - Upgrade DIG tool to dig faster.

-changed - astar mixer mananger- rules for mixer are changed. From now on pobject has to deliver to mixer 1000 of ingredients , but after that basically mixer will add product to dropzone virtually - no pobj is needed for product delivery. In code new mixer build, and a lot of under the hood changes for mixers to simplify production. As a overall design all that means less walking for RoundOnes. When Mixer ingredients are  too low than use +ASSIGN button to redeliver ingredients. Mixer is semi automatic from now on.

notes.title: 0.8.1.0 update. New units: YETI , DROID and DINOSAURS
notes.content:
update to 0.8.1.0
Main features in this update are: 
-New UNITS: YETI, DROID.
-New animals: dinosaurs
- upgrade system for RoundOnes



bug fixes:

quiet bug fixes (on 10/21/21)
-added new tiles 33,34,35,36,37,38 to astar as obstacles............................................fixed
-generate world without preview choosing error due to paralax not set...................fixed

regular bug fixes:
-sleep capsules [26,29,44] code optimizations avoid not necessary code
 in every frame redone base clase as build26......................................................................fixed
-astar_sleep_manager fixes/optimization.............................................................................fixed
-sending to sleep list while on returned list .........................................................................fixed
-fixed build 3 [bridge] to accommodate folowpath7..........................................................fixed
-partially redone astar_build_manager (read more in additions).................................fixed
-fixed random postition for npc,pobj to stay away from edges......................................fixed
-fixed possibility of setting pobj number in new game generator..................................fixed
-fixed movement on stairs up and down according to stairs type [67,70,88]............fixed
-fixed domesticated field not spawning [26,27,28,29,30 tiles].......................................fixed
-fixed in animal base classs-turn off pobj detection if self NOT dog.............................fixed
-fixed lowering stamina while sleeping(==to =in restbodygivesleep flag)...................fixed
-fixed speed penalties after loading from file.........................................................................fixed
-fixed animals layer 8 not destroying builds...........................................................................fixed
-fixed mixer ingredients (added 0 as 3rd element)..............................................................fixed
-fixed movement on ramp if below is air [added if no build present check]...............fixed

changes:
- changed kohokia bonus to be 2000 potato - food is very important in early game
- changed 80 percent working bonus to be 200 basic tools

optimizations:
-fixed physics engine on off for pobj (when not needed will turn off).................optimized
-getting grid coordinates for pobj getI getJ (cast int insted of floor).....................optimized

Additions:
-added BOULDER tiles on map edges, to avoid falling of map, which in turn
caused problems with minimap.
-added DUCATS - money for RoundOne when tile is dig out, RoundOne will get 1 Ducat.
For now Ducats to spent  are used in upgrade panel.
-added RoundOnes upgrade system. Upgrades are accessible from Roundones panel with this icon:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/c7851511943162f75766e857009886ae75faaef2.png[/img]
Upgrade panel will open:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/6414fa6bca03c18e0431b05525dad593c7b02d3a.png[/img]
Than you can see what could be upgraded for that RoundOne. Possible to upgrade:
A. Build TOOL. better tool will allow to set BUILDS faster
B. FOOD level - using backpack and loading food items to it RoundOne is loosing food level much slower. Put more food to backpack than effect is stronger
C. SLEEP/REST level - using thermos and loading drink items to it will couse that RoundOne is loosing 
sleep level much slower. Again more item you use in thermos the stronger the effect will be. I added
coffee and berry tea as new Mixer products to use in this upgrade.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/62faacd635b4ee4dc96d4edea14e5c7eb298a6e8.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/6392cab988fe5e2d15d221ff1fd100cb9762f40e.png[/img]

In general upgrades are taking pElement from DROPZONE and DUCATS from RounONES. Upgrades will significantly slower of loosing food and rest For example default food drop level is 4, every slot in backpack will lower that for 0.5, so maximum will be 2, that's 50% less. Same with rest maximum is 50% effect. They will NOT have to go to sleep and for food that often. Focus on one RondOne and try to do all upgrades for him - he will be more productive. Also please remember that penalties are activated for RoundOne if food or rest level fall below 100. Penalty is slower walking. To get it back to normal walking speed you need to provide food and rest (both above 100 will deactivate penalty).

-changed astar_build_manager rules. From now on RoundOnes will not
go to DROPZNOE when setting BUILDS for every load material
Instead they will stay by BUILD in progress and get material from DROPZONE 
and do BUILD animation using BUILD tool. (which you can upgrade by the way)
Reason for that change - it was too much movement on map already.
fixed/cleaned code in build manager.
-added possibility to send roundones to food storage-use pizza button on panel


New UNITS:
-Yeti added - in early game after digging Permafrost tile you can defrost YETI in DEFROSTER.
This character is acting as strong RoundOnes, Yeti can move 250 instead of 100 so digging
with YETI help will go much faster. Yeti is moving slowly - he was just defrosted don't rush him. Yeti can use all upgrades. Yeti is very expensive because building
 too many of them will slow game performance. Maybe I will limit that differently too. 

-Dinosaurs added - for now they act as NON domesticated animals - meaning they will 
destroy BUILDS. To Rebuild dinosaurs in CELL BUILDER you need FOSSILS pElement and 
DNA sequencer - both available in SUPERBIOLOGY epoch. For now two dinosaurs are in game: Brontosaur, Stegosaur.
-DROID added - in late game, build from Computer chip. Droid can move 250, so digging will be fast. It lives on battery power , so NO food or rest is needed. After battery is depleted you can choose to reload electricity (if you have it), or if not DROID will vanish. Droid cannot use upgrades for now.

In summary to get YETI,DROID and DINOSAURs you need to unlock specific pElement - check game  Encyclopedia. When you will have that, automatically menu will be unlocked for that pElement like for every other BUILD menu. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/407e40d46cf8d9a142e4691155671059117256a9.png[/img]
Those BUILDS act very similar to SEED BUILDS - after placing there is counter ,after reaching 0 
those new units will be placed on map. Below BUILD counter is 51 for next dinosaur.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/c2f2b8fd11479df7aec01b863ae95f084d0a3c51.png[/img]

Panels for new units:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/b4f19f6b59b06a76091def363cd3b4032d108271.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/d67d66f9e9cdb1aec27bccbdfea2891f671266a1.png[/img]

notes:
Most important fixes in this update were:
-sleep manager
-build manger
under the hood fixes, which are not that visible at first, but they will improve gameplay
quality.
All those additions and fixes required some new changes in load/save system therefore
after updating yours old game saves will NOT work. All additions are supported in LOAD/SAVE.
I added one dinosaur to tutorial map, so you can see how they look. 
Next update will focus on bug fixes.
Thank You

notes.title: update 7.7.1 life support system
notes.content:
-life properties: food level (purple), sleep level(orange) and already in game stamina level(green)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/a17bf336500c67bd6b584333e7886ca152b6aa3e.png[/img]
From Now on You need to take care of necessities for RoundOnes. They will walk much slower if they will not get sleep and food.

-introducing SLEEPING CAPSULES BUILDS: 3 new builds in category: life support : ground, mud brick and wood plank sleep capsules. Capsules can be build like any other regular builds. assignment to capsule of pobj will happen if pobj will walk by sleep capsule or if this will never happened also automatically after some time. Every pobject which was already delivering to dropzone should have sleeping capsule for reasons to get rest when sleep/rest level drop below 250. If sleep level will be below 250 pobject will abandon his task(work/build task for now) and go to His capsule to get rest.
Better sleep capsule will recharge sleep faster. Sleep comfort for now is best for wood planks capsule
Sleep capsule needs to be protected from enemies and wild animals they will damage those builds, how strong is indicated in <> , best one again is  wood planks sleep capsule : strength <650>.
Damaging by enemy will require planning builds; maybe use whole FORT builds for that reasons: gates, floors, walls. to actually build FORT to protect everything inside
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/6d89f4ce2d6b061a545482fd8e28cf170fcbdf9d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/55528f6c2e641f7019bcc63577d79ec65090e958.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/195077ff673807dfc7782b8abfee1a0cfd4a6484.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/c3cd73094393477a94c783762dcce550b0b161e7.png[/img]
Penalty for not using sleep capsules is: stamina will be depleted much faster, and pobj will move much slower. penalty will be activated if sleep is below 100 and speeding up game will not work for that pobject


-introducing FOOD STORAGE BUILDS: 3 new builds in that category: ground, fine stone and plastic FOOD STORAGE BUILDS. Build them as usually, after that pobject will need to deliver food to them. Those builds have food slots. Each slots will be loaded up to 500. (for now make sure that you have 500 or more of that food source) After slots are full FOOD STORAGE build will  start to function, giving food to passing pobjects. If food slots are empty FOOD can be reloaded to the same BUILD. Of course FOOD STORAGE with more slots are recharging FOOD stronger to pOBJECTs.
Food storage builds will be damaged by enemies and wild animals so you need to protect them, use FORT BUILDS for that.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/9b5dbcc6b9d8c809742d89e9f6bfc303403418b8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/e9b35d0ceac8acabd2b8902c5c132c8b21299075.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/9a7a1b3c88a003ddcd93cd007a998dda6730e220.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/9cf55742056f6d8f4b6d8d39f281930905df2462.png[/img]
Penalty for not using food storage is: stamina will be depleted much faster, and pobj will move much slower. penalty will be activated if food level is below 100 and speeding up game will not work for that pobject

After this update there is a change in game play, from now on You need to provide food and sleep to RoundONes, at the beginning some food scattered on map (potato,berries) will be enough but later you need to start developing in mixers SEEDs. Seeds will unlock  FARMING builds which already were in game. In my opinion that life support system was key element in game , now You need to use FORT builds to protect base, food storages, sleep capsules building basically FORT. Without that enemies and wild animals will destroy them very easy and you will loose precious resources. Now you not only has game objective to look after but FARMING is necessary part of game play. 

This update took longer time to code, after that I will take some time to debug those new features.
System like that is scattered in code in many places In whole game. (uff all that took 2-3 weeks to code) Also old saves will be broken and will give error after that update. I had to implement a lot of new functions in LOAD/SAVE to support life support system thereof:
Life support system is fully supported in LOAD / SAVE functionality. 

Thank You

notes.title: BUILD is FUN update
notes.content:
update to 0.7.5.0. in that update main features are:
-BUILD is FUN. It means that BUILDS can now be placed anywhere in air using SCAFOLDING. that is completely automatic. After builds are done scaffolding is gone. Accessing tiles in air was main limitation and now that is gone. You can build any structures using MAIN blocks. All BUILDS will have them. New builds possible to built in air I named FORT BUILDS. I am tempted to change all builds to have that functionality. (let me know)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39665843/b4ebf32569579bf014c7756565b83a5a9e35a8f7.png[/img]

Structures placed on columns are FLOORS that can be used for any structures to be placed on them. FORT BUILDS are accessible during building to any place in air but after they are done , after scaffolding is gone then regular rules apply to walking on surfaces. So some blocks are blocking movement and some are allowing movement. Like it was before. I added a ton of NEW BUILDS which will allow movement: stairs, floors, gates, corridor, also walking on top of MAIN blocks is possible.
Panels columns, and building supports are only decorative and are not changing movement rules.

Main BUILDS added are FORT BUILDS made from : mud brick, fine stone, and marble slat.
